name: Fathom
summary: Parchment-toned growth agency site with a condensed serif voice, surreal classical AI imagery and botanical ivy cut-outs drifting over the scroll.

fonts.pairing: tight condensed serif display with italic accent words, small medium-weight grotesk for UI and body

signature: section header rule: terracotta dot eyebrow left, 'Label 2026' right, hairline, then serif title with a /N/ counter
alternating cream and deeper cream bands with one ink-black pricing band
transparent ivy sprigs parallaxing over a tall sticky scroll-reveal statement
imagery: surreal sepia AI scenes (classical columns, planets, robed figures), rounded 20px cards with text overlaid low
layout_grid: 1200px canvas, 64px side padding, 80px section padding, 2-column split cards, 4-column team
